name: Udupi

queries.query: Udupi Karnataka official GIS cadastral parcel map API land records Bhoomi site:gov.in
queries.result: First-party results identified the Government of India DILRMP Udupi map-digitization/ULPIN status page, the Karnataka land-record survey-number API documentation, the official Udupi District administrative page listing the Deputy Director of Land Records and Udupi Taluk Tahsildar, and the national NAKSHA urban parcel-mapping programme. No Udupi parcel feature response was returned by discovery.

queries.query: ಉಡುಪಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಅಧಿಕೃತ GIS ಕಂದಾಯ ಭೂ ದಾಖಲೆ ಪಾರ್ಸೆಲ್ ನಕ್ಷೆ API
queries.result: Kannada-language discovery was run against official Karnataka government domains. It returned official Karnataka RDPR material containing Udupi district/taluk/village records and the official Udupi District page with Kannada toggle, but no public Udupi parcel geometry endpoint or safe parcel feature response.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Kannada first-party discovery, followed by bounded anonymous TLS-verified GET attempts. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS disablement were used.

portalsFound.observation: Official Government of Karnataka regional commissioner page for Udupi District. It identifies the Deputy Director, Land Records and the Udupi Taluk Tahsildar, evidencing a local/district registry custodian; it does not expose parcel geometry in the page response.

Official DILRMP Udupi status page found through discovery. It reports cadastral-map digitization/geo-referencing and ULPIN-related progress for Udupi district, but is status evidence rather than an open parcel feature service.

Official Karnataka public API help page documents a GET survey-number route requiring village, wscode, district, taluk and hobli. It documents request parameters and JSON format, but not parcel polygon geometry or an Udupi-specific unit selection.
Official national NAKSHA urban land-record mapping programme page. It is general programme context and does not establish Udupi coverage or an accessible Udupi parcel layer.

requests.assessment: Anonymous TLS-verified request timed out after 20 seconds before a response. Required village/wscode/hobli identifiers were not safely guessable, so no follow-up query was made. This is a route/identifier failure, not evidence of parcel absence.
Anonymous TLS-verified request timed out after 20 seconds. No viewer JavaScript/configuration, service URL, schema, CRS, native ID or geometry was obtained.
Official status route returned a gateway failure in the web fetch. Search-result content still evidenced Udupi DILRMP status, but no live parcel response was obtained.
Official programme page timed out; no Udupi-specific map configuration or parcel schema was obtained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Karnataka/Udupi district land-record custody, DILRMP cadastral-map status, and the documented Karnataka survey-number API.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local/district custodian and national/state land-record programme evidence only; no open Udupi parcel geometry coverage verified.

remainingUncertainty: The current Karnataka viewer/API configuration, Udupi urban/taluk/village identifiers, parcel schema, CRS, stable native identity, update currency and citywide completeness remain unresolved. The exact WUP point was preserved and never shifted; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made. A timeout, gateway failure or unusable route is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence. Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial qualification.
